# AvantSpecs

> AvantSpecs is a merchant export house based in Rohtak, India, sourcing, testing, and shipping essential oils, oleoresins, spices, nuts, powders, and eco disposables to wholesale buyers, formulators, and flavour houses worldwide. Every consignment ships with a full documentation set (COA, TDS, SDS, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Commercial Invoice & Packing List, Bill of Lading, and an Allergen/Non-GMO Declaration).

## Product Register

12 core SKUs across six categories. Full details, MOQ, and COA availability at https://avantspecs.com/register, or view an individual product at https://avantspecs.com/product/<id>.

- Essential Oils: Eucalyptus Oil, Clove Bud Oil, Lemongrass Oil, Citronella Oil
- Oleoresins: Black Pepper Oleoresin
- Spices: Saffron, Cumin Seed
- Nuts: Cashew Kernels
- Powders: Guar Gum Powder, Onion Powder, Potato Powder
- Eco Disposables: Areca Leaf Plates
